name: Szögliget (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szögliget: a green and red shield with a tower and a tree, with a helm, a griffin crest and mantling, above a scroll inscribed SZÖGLIGET.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
